prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium editorial lifestyle photograph for the image half of a wellness product story card. Landscape 3:2 format. A woman in her early fifties with short salt-and-pepper hair and a warm medium complexion walks naturally along a safe, broad coastal trail in beautiful morning light. She wears an understated navy windbreaker, sand-colored walking trousers and comfortable shoes, with no logos. Candid, thoughtful, engaged expression, looking toward the ocean rather than at the camera. The image expresses the idea of a full, active life; no exaggerated athletic performance or staged victory pose. Rich blue ocean, pale silver-blue sky, subtle warm sunlight, textured coastal grasses and a curving trail. Place the full-body walker in the upper-right half, occupying about half the image height, with a visibly complete natural walking stride. Make the lower-left quarter a quiet dark blue-green area of coastal grasses and shadow for a white headline to be placed later. Cinematic but believable natural photography, real skin and fabric texture, sophisticated restrained colors, atmospheric depth, gentle breeze. No text, no lettering, no bottles or packaging, no tablets, no laboratory graphics, no mitochondria, no diagrams, no watermarks. One coherent photograph.
